facts.claim: BCPL’s currently linked Study Room Policy, approved October 2023, does not require a library card to reserve a room. Procedures, time limits and availability vary by branch; call the branch before relying on a room. One customer may reserve one study room at a time.
quote: Approved 10/2023
Study rooms vary across the system; call the specific branch to learn about specific reservation procedures, time limits, and availability.
A library card is not required for reservation.
A single customer may only reserve 1 study room at a time.

facts.claim: Under the linked October 2023 policy, study-room use must finish 15 minutes before closing. A reservation may be given to someone waiting after a 15-minute no-show; library activities take priority and reservations may be changed or cancelled. Do not rely on a study room as a guaranteed retreat.
quote: Approved 10/2023
All room usage must conclude 15 minutes prior to the Library's posted closing time.
If a person/group does not show up for their scheduled reservation of the study room, after 15 minutes the Library holds the right to give the room away to a customer who might be waiting.
Library sponsored activities take precedence over non-Library uses of the study rooms.
The Library reserves the right to change or cancel any study room reservation if circumstances at the Library so demand, including room reassignment based upon size of the group.
